name: opencode-switchboard-demo
description: Records and renders the switchboard demo video and GIFs. Not part of the published package.

scripts.record: cd .. && bun run build && cd demo && env -u OPENCODE_CLI_CONFIG_CONTENT -u OPENCODE_SESSION_ID -u OPENCODE -u OPENCODE_TERMINAL OPENCODE_DRIVE_MEDIA_DIR=$HOME/.cache/opencode-switchboard-demo/recordings opencode-drive run ./record.ts
